pine needle javelin.desc: a dead brown pine needle. A bit bulky to wield, and too light to do proper damage.

greenwood bow.desc: a greenwood bow with raw silk bowstring. Fires arrows made of sapped wood splinters.

slingshot.desc: a wooden slingshot that uses the elasticity of spider silk to shoot sharp rocks.

splinter spear.desc: a wooden splinter hardened with plant sap.

chitin spiked mace.desc: a chitin spiked mace that somewhat preserves the previous shape of an ant leg.

ant leg.desc: a limb broken off from a dead ant. It is pretty strong and could be used to swing around.

web bolas.desc: a bola made with spiderwebs. Can be thrown to entangle and swung to damage.

silk robe.desc: a silk robe made from silkworm threads.

silk pants.desc: a silk pants made from silkworm threads. Very common.

grass robe.desc: a grass robe made from woven grass fibers. Provides very little warmth.

long chitin jacket.desc: a long jacket crafted from the chitin of a long bodied bug. +1 Health.

chitin breastplate.desc: a plate breastplate crafted from pill bug chitin.

spine spear.desc: a short spear made of hardened bug spine. Can be thrown.

hair ball.desc: a poisonous hair ball. Can be hurled at melee or ranged distance to poison enemies.

needle claw.desc: a claw weapon made from the legs of a millipede.

bloodquito proboscis.desc: the proboscis of the dreaded bloodquito. Grants you lifesteal attacks.

homebound scroll.desc: a scroll of teleportation bound to Ant Hill. Use to instantly teleport there.

human corpse.desc: a human corpse. Could be edible, I guess.

bug meat.desc: a bug meat, which is the main source of food for people. You can boil, roast, grill, stir fry, or cook it over fire on a stick! Eat to regenerate health.

blood droplet.desc: a drop of blood. It sticks to you, making it convenient to carry around. Leaves an unpleasant taste in your mouth, but is very fulfilling.

sturdy wood.desc: a sturdy wood suitable for construction.
